svg.title: beyond, r5: differences at field 0.5, tangential
svg.desc: For each pair of the request, the first engine's curve minus the second's at each frequency where both are finite numbers, each engine by the answer the comparison judges (its last step where that step has data, else its first answer); the shaded band is the attention band or the tolerance the policy gives the rung at that field. The comparison sets this field aside for lv and optiland as data (chief-landing-apart), so their differences enter no band.
